# Claude Allowed Tools - Minimal Safe LPZRobots Development Kit
# Only tools that are actually used and safe for CI/CD

# Core shells (no sudo for safety)
Bash(bash:*),Bash(sh:*),

# Version control
Bash(git:*),Bash(gh:*),Bash(diff:*),Bash(patch:*),

# File operations (essential)
Bash(ls:*),Bash(cp:*),Bash(mv:*),Bash(rm:*),Bash(mkdir:*),Bash(touch:*),Bash(ln:*),Bash(cd:*),Bash(pwd:*),Bash(basename:*),Bash(dirname:*),Bash(realpath:*),Bash(cat:*),Bash(head:*),Bash(tail:*),Bash(less:*),Bash(grep:*),Bash(find:*),Bash(xargs:*),Bash(tee:*),Bash(sort:*),Bash(uniq:*),Bash(cut:*),Bash(tr:*),Bash(printf:*),Bash(echo:*),Bash(file:*),Bash(stat:*),Bash(du:*),Bash(wc:*),Bash(tar:*),Bash(gzip:*),Bash(gunzip:*),Bash(zip:*),Bash(unzip:*),Bash(mktemp:*),

# Text processing (used in build scripts)
Bash(sed:*),Bash(awk:*),

# Build systems (all used by LPZRobots)
Bash(cmake:*),Bash(make:*),Bash(ninja:*),Bash(autoconf:*),Bash(automake:*),Bash(autoreconf:*),Bash(libtool:*),Bash(m4:*),Bash(pkg-config:*),Bash(./configure:*),Bash(./bootstrap:*),

# LPZRobots specific scripts
Bash(./createNewSimulation.sh:*),Bash(./start:*),

# C++ compilation
Bash(gcc:*),Bash(g++:*),Bash(clang:*),Bash(clang++:*),Bash(ar:*),Bash(ranlib:*),Bash(nm:*),Bash(objdump:*),Bash(ldd:*),Bash(c++filt:*),Bash(strings:*),

# Static analysis
Bash(cppcheck:*),Bash(clang-tidy:*),Bash(clang-format:*),

# Debugging (non-interactive)
Bash(addr2line:*),Bash(gcov:*),Bash(lcov:*),Bash(gcovr:*),

# Qt tools (needed for GUI)
Bash(qmake:*),Bash(moc:*),

# Documentation
Bash(doxygen:*),

# Essential utilities
Bash(env:*),Bash(export:*),Bash(which:*),Bash(test:*),Bash(true),Bash(false),Bash(date:*),Bash(sleep:*),

# Network (for dependencies)
Bash(curl:*),Bash(wget:*),

# Claude helpers
Task,TodoWrite,Read,Write,Edit,Replace,MultiEdit,Glob,Grep,WebFetch(domain:**)
